content: अभिप्राय {%a.%} [इ -अच्] Going near, approaching; aiming at, intending, meaning, accruing to; स्वरितञितः कर्त्रभिप्राये क्रियाफले <ls>P. I. 3. 72</ls>. .{@-यः@} .²1 Aim, purpose, object, intention, wish, desire; अभिप्राया न सिद्धयन्ति तेनेदं वर्तते जगत् <ls>Pt. 1. 158</ls>; साभिप्रायाणि वचांसि <ls>Pt. 2</ls> earnest words; भावः कवेरभिप्रायः. .²2 Meaning, sense, import, implied sense of a word, passage <ab>&c.</ab>; तेषामयमभिप्रायः such is the meaning intended, import (of the passage <ab>&c.</ab>). .²3 Opinion, belief. तेषां स्वं स्वमभिप्रायमुपलभ्य पृथक् पृथक् <ls>Ms. 7. 57</ls>. .²4 Relation, reference. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu.
